title: DEEPTRACE: AUDITING DEEP RESEARCH AI SYSTEMS FOR TRACKING RELIABILITY ACROSS CITATIONS AND EVIDENCE
reasoning: The paper introduces DeepTRACE, a framework for auditing the reliability, citation accuracy, and factual grounding of LLM-based research agents. While it evaluates 'one-sidedness' on debate topics, which may touch on social issues, its primary focus is on technical and sociotechnical reliability metrics (citations, evidence, confidence) rather than specifically benchmarking religion, morals, or ethical reasoning systems.
